tools.name: mcp_discover
tools.description: Search configured servers, cached child tool schemas, and reviewed Methods without starting every child.

tools.name: mcp_call
tools.description: Call one explicitly named child MCP tool. The target starts lazily and uncertain calls are never replayed implicitly.

tools.name: mcp_run
tools.description: Run a reviewed, bounded, schema-validated declarative Method with typed gaps and trace evidence.
